title: Reproduce and identify deferred cancellation heartbeat loss
goal: Create a controlled failing regression and identify event-loop, heartbeat or admission evidence before choosing a causal fix
acceptance: A committed deterministic regression explains the observed worker connection loss
Distinguish fixture timing sensitivity from production behavior
Preserve cancellation replay and fail-closed resource ownership
privacy: Neutral repository fixtures only; no model inference, private hosts or device operations
validation: Independent review before a causal fix closes the parent
escalation: Do not merely widen timeouts or weaken assertions
Keep uncertain external effects held until reconciled

effort.basis: Estimate added at featurePlans adoption (2026-11-11): Controlled reproduction of the deferred-cancellation heartbeat loss under CPU contention, then classification; parent Investigate/Medium. Estimate, not a measurement. Implemented 2026-11-11 in about 0.75 agent hours (stated: mechanism read from the timing reassessment, one failed one-turn attempt, the late-timeout grace, local runs); review and CI remain. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0: baseline 2 days from the original estimate; remaining 0.25 day for review and CI. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 0.5 hours agent; implemented in about 0.75 agent hours (stated); 0.5 h remains for review and CI. Method: a judged rate of about 1.5 agent hours per former focused day, not a calculation, informed by NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge, a throughput proxy: median about 0.56 h, p75 2.1–2.7 h by quantile method, p90 about 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement); a step that is a PR of its own takes at least 0.75 h with review and CI, while an agent part that only prepares or records for an owner step may be less. Machine time of real-model or device runs is not counted. Baseline 1.25 h = 0.75 h spent + 0.5 h remaining. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 2 kept as history.
